neighbours.label: the short word-initial prefix piece ' ab' / ' an' / ' tri' when the tokenizer splits a word there (ab|normally, an|ergy, tri|athlon)
fire: Doctors noticed that the baby's skull was abnormally shaped.
The fluid levels in her lungs were abnormally high for weeks.
Some of the patients' white cells behaved abnormally in the lab.
My cousin is training for a triathlon in the mountains this summer.
Thousands of athletes entered the triathlon held along the coast.
Without a second signal, the T cells slip into anergy and stop responding.
The clinic treats teenagers struggling with anorexia and other eating disorders.
The scan revealed a small aneurysm in one artery of his brain.
quiet: Doctors noticed that the baby's skull was unusually shaped.
The fluid levels in her lungs were very high for weeks.
Some of the patients' white cells behaved strangely in the lab.
My cousin is training for a marathon in the mountains this summer.
Thousands of athletes entered the race held along the coast.
Without a second signal, the T cells become inactive and stop responding.
The clinic treats teenagers struggling with depression and other mood disorders.
The scan revealed a small clot in one artery of his brain.

notes: probe: ab|normally 0.52, an|ergy 0.48, tri|athlon 0.32, an|emia 0.20; other split words (aberr|ant, trib|utary, abs|cess) ~0; article ' an' ~0.2.
